title: 第3章 神道高手魑离第4章 特殊事件 退婚
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
【方玉凝】
【武道：凝血九层（一品）】
【神道：凝魂七层（一品）】
【气运等级：青（黑、白、绿、青、蓝、紫、橙......）】
【情绪值：70】
【功法：《太玄气经（一）》（六品高阶）】
【异火：青鸾玉火】
【幻术：迷幻术（三品高阶）】
【武技：踏风步（四品高阶）、崩云劲（四品高阶）、玄阴针法（三品高阶）】
【护卫：神道（魑离-玄魄七层）、武道（不动山-玄骨七层）】
【物品：敛息戒、甘露方、凝气散方、归元丹方...】
此方世界，武道和神道皆分为十品
其中武道为：一品凝血、二品通脉、三品玄骨、四品神藏、五品命府......
神道分为：一品凝魂，二品灵窍、三品玄魄、四品神台、五品玉楼......
“呼~”
睫毛颤动间，方玉凝檀口微张，吐出一尺白气。
她按照《太玄气经》的心法口诀运转周天。
直到体内因突破境界而涌现的磅礴力量，渐渐趋于平稳时，才停下手中印诀。
周身气息收敛，方玉凝缓缓起身，活动了一下身体，只感觉轻快不少。
“这就是凝血境九层？”

望着嫩白如玉的小手，感受着其中的力量，方玉凝喃喃道。
林家所处地界，名为云川-福州城。
城中似林家这般的家族，还有吴、孙两家。
三家皆是城中霸主。
据她所知，除福州城主外，福州城修为最高者，莫过于三家家主。
大概也就是在二品通脉境巅峰到三品玄骨境之间。
就是不知道，现在的她搭配上异火，能不能秒杀二品通脉境武者。
突发奇想下，方玉凝捡起地上一块青石，不断揉搓着。
随着嫩白小手不断发力，青石顿时化作石粉从指缝中飘出。
手掌摊开，青白火焰自掌心中燃烧，就连石粉都被烧了个干净。
“唉呀，这么暴力不行，有点崩人设~”
意识到刚刚到动作粗鲁，有些破坏自己长久以来经营的“小白花”形象。
方玉凝自说自话的拍了拍脸蛋，开始调整表情。
又整理了一番衣裙，确认没有问题后，她这才转身朝着山下走去。
脚步轻点，小巧绣鞋之下，真气爆涌。
一股风劲横生，将她整个人送了出去。
踏风步！
风劲涌动间，方玉凝宛若一只蝴蝶飞舞，身形快速朝山下飞去。
content_en:
【Fang Yuning】
[Martial Arts: Ninth Level of Blood Coagulation (First Grade)]
[Shinto: Seventh Level of Soul Condensation (First Grade)]
[Luck level: green (black, white, green, cyan, blue, purple, orange...)]
[Emotional value: 70]
[Exercise method: "Tai Xuan Qi Jing (1)" (sixth grade high level)]
[Strange Fire: Qingluan Jade Fire]
[Illusion: Psychedelic Technique (Third Grade High Level)]
[Martial skills: Wind Step (high-level fourth grade), Collapse of Cloud Strength (high-level fourth grade), Xuanyin Acupuncture (high-level third grade)]
[Guards: Shinto (Jieli-Xuanso Seventh Level), Martial Arts (Fudoyama-Xuanso Seventh Level)]
[Items: Breath Condensation Ring, Nectar Recipe, Qi Ning Powder Recipe, Guiyuan Dan Recipe...]
In this world, both martial arts and Shinto are divided into ten levels
Among them, the martial arts are: first-level blood coagulation, second-level meridians, third-level mysterious bones, fourth-level divine treasure, fifth-level life palace...
Shinto is divided into: first-level soul condensation, second-level spiritual aperture, third-level mysterious soul, fourth-level sacred platform, fifth-level jade tower...
"Huh~"
As her eyelashes trembled, Fang Yuning opened her mouth slightly and exhaled a foot of white air.
She circulates the heavens according to the mental formulas of "Tai Xuan Qi Jing".
It wasn't until the majestic power that emerged from the body's breakthrough realm gradually stabilized that he stopped sealing the seals in his hands.
The aura around her body converged, Fang Yuning slowly stood up, moved her body, and felt much lighter.
"Is this the ninth level of blood coagulation realm?"
Looking at the small white hands, feeling the power in them, Fang Yuning murmured.
The area where the Lin family is located is called Yunchuan-Fuzhou City.
There are families like the Lin family in the city, as well as the Wu and Sun families.
All three families are overlords in the city.
As far as she knew, apart from the lord of Fuzhou City, the one with the highest cultivation level in Fuzhou City was none other than the heads of the three families.
Probably between the peak of the second-grade Tongmai realm and the third-grade Xuangu realm.
I just don't know if she can instantly kill a second-grade Tongmai realm warrior if she is paired with the strange fire.
On a sudden whim, Fang Yuning picked up a piece of bluestone on the ground and kept rubbing it.
As the tender white hands continued to exert force, the bluestone suddenly turned into stone powder and floated out from between the fingers.
Opening his palms, green and white flames burned from his palms, even the stone powder was burned clean.
"Oh, it's not good to be so violent, it's a bit of a character~"
I realized that my actions just now were rude and somewhat damaged the "little white flower" image I had maintained for a long time.
Fang Yuning patted her face while talking to herself and began to adjust her expression.
After adjusting her clothes again and confirming that there was nothing wrong, she turned and walked down the mountain.
The steps were gentle, and the true energy surged under the small embroidered shoes.
A strong wind blew her away.
Step on the wind!
As the wind surged, Fang Yuning fluttered like a butterfly, flying quickly down the mountain.
